description: Returns the public keys that up to 100 users registered for X Chat encryption, looked up by numeric user ID. Each key carries the user_id of the user it belongs to. Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version, juicebox_config and user_id.

public_key.fields.description: A comma separated list of PublicKey fields to display.
